observations.note: The energy peaks as drum patterns open up, delivering a controlled impact.
The sitar remains intelligible but battles the midrange of the distorted guitars.
Rhythm guitars enter with a competent, moderately aggressive modern tone.
The rhythm section drives steadily forward but feels somewhat mechanical.
The track concludes with an abrupt, unnatural volume cut.
The upbeat prog instrumentation and raga phrasing successfully avoid a doom feel.

overall_note: A capable mid-tempo fusion piece that integrates sitar with progressive metal effectively. The mix gets slightly crowded, but the arrangement meets the stylistic prompt.
